title: Feature-Image Automation, One Year On: Evolution by Selection, the Gallery, and Why You Stay in Claude Code
description: The **applied / practice** half of a pair. Follow-up to the original feature-image-automation piece. What changed: evolution by artificial selection for prompts (fitness × recency, lineage forks), a lightweight gallery app for side-by-side review, and the deeper framing that the whole thing works because you don't leave Claude Code — the agent is the workflow, not a feature bolted onto one. Pairs with `evolution-by-artificial-selection-for-prompt-generation` (the theory/framework half); the two should cross-link.
